title: Stratum: A QoS Substrate Composing DiffServ, L4S, and CAKE in ns-3
description: Stratum is a composable QoS substrate for ns-3 hosting Differentiated Services, Low Latency Low Loss Scalable-throughput (L4S), and Common Applications Kept Enhanced (CAKE) as three first-class clients. Four pluggable primitives (Classify-and-Meter, Mark-and-Route, a per-class slot array, and an across-slot service policy) let any client compose a queueing discipline by picking one strategy per stage. The substrate inherits the 2001 DiffServ4NS ns-2 module as its classical-DiffServ client.
